card.name: Counted events before 'per week' or 'each year'
card.fires_on: The last word of a count or frequency phrase, such as 'one litter', 'a few times' or 'once', just before a time unit like 'per year', 'a week', 'daily' or 'each year'.

modes.label: Count then 'times'
modes.description: The word 'times' or a counted noun after 'a few' or 'two or three', right before 'a week'.
modes.example: anemia can be treated with a genetically engineered form of EPO that is usually injected under the skin two or three<< times>> a week.

modes.label: Event verb before 'each year'
modes.description: A verb or noun for something that happens at a yearly or weekly rate, followed by 'each year' or 'annually'.
modes.example: about 1,000 of these lions are<< killed>> each year.

modes.label: Dosing frequency
modes.description: 'once' or a meal reference in instructions about how often to take a drug.
modes.example: Montelukast sodium should be taken<< once>> daily in the evening.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write 'each' or 'every' (including Chinese 每) as the next word, giving a rate such as 'each year'.
card.plain: It fires on a word that gives how often something happens, just before the time period such as 'each year' or 'a week'.
